_comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for the About / Our Team section. Edit here, then run `node build.js`. Bios are verbatim from the current site; edit only for clarity per Amanda's approval.

team.name: Amanda (Mandy) Robles
team.bio: Mandy launched Middle Rock Management in 2025, primarily as a means to support bold, authentic voices and the stories they tell. As MRM continues to grow, Mandy is dedicated to maintaining an environment of integrity, humanity, and gratitude.

team.name: Corrine Ashley
team.bio: After launching her own company, Corrine has joined forces with Mandy and Middle Rock Management to create a fearless partnership built on passion, grit, and a shared mission to build artists' careers, come hell or high water.
